scale.label: Expert
scale.descriptor: Accurate defensible reproducible and decision-ready work; integrates evidence limitations and implications independently.

scale.label: Proficient
scale.descriptor: Technically correct and usable work with minor omissions that do not alter the substantive conclusion.

scale.label: Developing
scale.descriptor: Partially correct work requiring material revision before professional use.

scale.label: Beginning
scale.descriptor: Major conceptual methodological or evidential weaknesses.
